name: schema-extraction
description: Fill fixed fields from a short financial document: its kind, currency, and whether a due date is stated. All text is synthetic. Baseline rules were written against the dev split only.

kind.instructions: What kind of document is this?

criteria.invoice: A request for payment for goods or services, not yet paid
criteria.receipt: Proof that a payment was already made
criteria.statement: A periodic summary of account activity and balance
criteria.quote: An estimate of a future price that is not yet a bill

currency.instructions: Which currency are the amounts in?

criteria.none: No amount or currency is stated

due_date.instructions: The document states a date by which payment is due

criteria.true: A due date or payment deadline is written in the text
